channel.title: Wallace & Gromit: A Grand Day Out
channel.desc: BAFTA-winning, Oscar-nominated claymation by Nick Park, which introduced the world to inventor Wallace and his canine companion Gromit. The pair blast off in a homemade rocket to go on a bank holiday outing to the moon and test the theory that it is made of cheese. What they find there surprises them. Featuring the voice of Peter Sallis (Wallace).
